name: dsh-throttle
description: A /throttle three-tier mode for the DeepSeek Harness: it contracts a session's boundaries into one of three positions — Tight (the tier a session starts in: cheapest declared reasoning level, view-only permissions, the tightest per-turn ceiling), Wide (configurable reasoning effort, the session's own permission preset restored, a larger ceiling that still holds), and Open (no ceiling, no effort override, permissions untouched — as if the plugin were not installed). The tier, the reason behind the current file policy and the live per-turn budget are published to the model; the Web UI carries a tier chip beside the model selector in the composer bar, and the ceilings are edited on the Plugins page instead of YAML.

meta.title: Throttle
meta.description: /throttle holds one session inside one of three boundaries. Tight (default): reasoning low, view-only, ≤4 steps / ≤2 min. Wide: reasoning high, the session's own writable preset restored, ≤5 steps / ≤5 min. Open: no ceiling, no reasoning override, permissions back to the session. A session started by subagent follows the tier of the session that started it, on a budget of its own. The tier chip sits beside the model selector in the composer bar; the ceilings are edited on the Plugins page and take effect without a restart.
